Upper Text: ＜DNA Digivolution: 0 from yellow Lv.5 + purple Lv.5＞
Digivolve unsuspended with the 2 specified Digimon stacked on top of each other.

[When Digivolving] Place 1 yellow or purple Digimon card from your trash on top of your security stack face down. If DNA digivolving, you may search your security stack for 1 level 5 or lower Digimon card and play it without paying the cost. Then, shuffle your security stack.
[All Turns] When you play another Digimon by an effect, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with a level less than or equal to the played Digimon's level.
